note: Extra English strings used by stats_src templates as {{str:KEY}}. Ability names/descriptions come from fft_jobs.json ({{name:ID}}, {{desc:ID}}), job passive texts from the job list ({{jobname:ID}}, {{jobdesc:ID}}).

strings.RoyalGrace.Name: Royal Grace
strings.RoyalGrace.Desc: While Princess is your job, every spell you cast that restores hit points also restores 1d6 of yours.
strings.EngineeredShots.Name: Engineered Shots
strings.EngineeredShots.Desc: While Machinist is your job, your ranged weapon hits deal 1d4 extra damage.
strings.MonsterHunter.Name: Monster Hunter
strings.MonsterHunter.Desc: While Game Hunter is your job, your weapon hits deal 1d6 extra damage to creatures that aren't humanoid.
strings.StarReading.Name: Star Reading
strings.StarReading.Desc: While Astrologer is your job you read what the stars hold: +3 to initiative.
strings.SteelBody.Name: Steel Body
strings.SteelBody.Desc: While Steel Giant is your job you resist poison damage and can't be poisoned.
strings.HolyMagicks.Name: Holy Magicks
strings.MartialArts.Name: Martial Arts
strings.MartialArts.Desc: While Monk is your job, your unarmed attacks use the higher of your Strength and Dexterity for attack and damage rolls (armour allowed), and after an unarmed attack you can make an unarmed strike as a bonus action that turn (Martial Strike).
strings.MartialStrike.Name: Martial Strike
strings.MartialStrike.Desc: Make an unarmed strike as a bonus action. Only after an unarmed attack this turn (Martial Arts).
strings.HolyMagicks.Desc: While Cleric is your job, every spell you cast that restores hit points restores 1d6 more.
strings.JobBoard.Name: Job Board
strings.JobBoard.Desc: Open the FFT Job Board: change jobs, learn abilities and set your secondary, reaction, support and movement slots. Free; does not use your turn.
strings.JobPassive.Desc: Current FFT job. Change it on the Job Board.
strings.Training.Name: JP Training (test)
strings.Training.Desc: Testing tool: every party member gets JP (1,000 by default) in each job they have unlocked, so you can try the jobs without grinding. Jobs it unlocks get JP from the next cast. Free; does not use your turn.
strings.status.FFTJ_FOCUS.name: Focus
strings.status.FFTJ_DEFEND.name: Defending
strings.status.FFTJ_REND_ARMOR.name: Armor Rent
strings.status.FFTJ_REND_WEAPON.name: Weapon Rent
strings.status.FFTJ_REND_SPEED.name: Speed Rent
strings.status.FFTJ_REND_POWER.name: Power Rent
strings.status.FFTJ_REND_MAGICK.name: Magick Rent
strings.status.FFTJ_REND_MAGICK.desc: -2 spell save DC and -2 to spell attack rolls.
strings.status.FFTJ_AUTOPOTION_USED.name: Auto-Potion Used
strings.status.FFTJ_SPEED_SURGE.name: Speed Surge
strings.status.FFTJ_MANAFONT_USED.name: Mana Font Used
strings.status.FFTJ_MANAFONT_USED.desc: Mana Font already gave back a spell slot this round.
strings.status.FFTJ_REBIRTH.name: Rebirth
strings.status.FFTJ_REBIRTH.desc: The next time this creature would drop to 0 hit points, it stays up with a quarter of its hit points instead.
strings.status.FFTJ_REGEN.name: Regen
strings.status.FFTJ_REGEN.desc: Regains 1d4+1 HP at the start of each turn.
strings.status.FFTJ_PROTECT.name: Protect
strings.status.FFTJ_SHELL.name: Shell
strings.status.FFTJ_SHELL.desc: Advantage on saving throws against spells.
strings.status.FFTJ_DOOM.name: Doom
strings.passive.FFTJ_OnionKnight_5.name: Onion Knight Lv5
strings.passive.FFTJ_OnionKnight_5.desc: +1 AC and +1 to attack rolls while Onion Knight is your job.
strings.passive.FFTJ_OnionKnight_8.name: Onion Knight Lv8
strings.passive.FFTJ_OnionKnight_8.desc: +2 to every ability score, +2 AC and +2 to attack rolls while Onion Knight is your job.
strings.status.FFTJ_STOP.name: Stop
strings.status.FFTJ_STOP.desc: Frozen in time: can't move or act; melee hits are critical. Repeats the Wisdom save each turn.
strings.status.FFTJ_IMMOBILIZE.name: Immobilize
strings.status.FFTJ_IMMOBILIZE.desc: Can't move, but can still act. Repeats the Strength save each turn.
strings.status.FFTJ_FLOAT.name: Float
strings.status.FFTJ_FLOAT.desc: Can't be knocked prone and ignores difficult terrain.
strings.status.FFTJ_REFLECT.name: Reflect
strings.status.FFTJ_REFLECT.desc: Takes half damage from spells; a caster whose spell deals damage takes 2d6 force damage.
strings.status.FFTJ_QUICK.name: Quick
strings.status.FFTJ_SWIFTSPELL.name: Swiftspell
strings.status.FFTJ_SWIFTSPELL.desc: The next spell that costs an action costs a bonus action instead.
strings.status.FFTJ_FAITH.name: Faith
strings.status.FFTJ_FAITH.desc: +2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC, -2 to saving throws.
strings.status.FFTJ_ATHEIST.name: Atheist
strings.status.FFTJ_ATHEIST.desc: Can't cast spells; advantage on saving throws against spells.
strings.status.FFTJ_UNDEAD.name: Undead
strings.status.FFTJ_UNDEAD.desc: Can't regain hit points; vulnerable to radiant damage.
strings.status.FFTJ_BERSERK.name: Berserk
strings.status.FFTJ_BERSERK.desc: Can't cast spells; deals 2 more damage; -2 AC.
strings.status.FFTJ_DISABLE.name: Disable
strings.status.FFTJ_DISABLE.desc: Can't take actions or bonus actions, but can move.
strings.status.FFTJ_STONE.name: Stone
strings.status.FFTJ_STONE.desc: Petrified: incapacitated and resistant to all damage.
strings.status.FFTJ_GOLEM.name: Golem
strings.status.FFTJ_GOLEM.desc: 15 temporary hit points from the Golem's shield.
strings.status.FFTJ_ENTICED.name: Enticed
strings.status.FFTJ_ENTICED.desc: Talked into switching sides: fights for the Orator's party on its own until this runs out.
strings.status.FFTJ_TAMED.name: Tamed
strings.status.FFTJ_TAMED.desc: Tamed by an Orator: fights for the Orator's party on its own until this runs out.
strings.status.FFTJ_TOAD.name: Toad
strings.status.FFTJ_TOAD.desc: Turned into a harmless critter by Geomancy (FFT's Toad; BG3 has sheep, not toads) until this ends.
strings.status.FFTJ_VANISH.name: Vanish
strings.status.FFTJ_VANISH.desc: Invisible: attacking or casting a spell ends it; being hit does not.
strings.status.FFTJ_SONG_SERAPH_FX.desc: Got back a level 1 spell slot from the song.
strings.status.FFTJ_SONG_LIFE_FX.desc: Regains 1d4 hit points at the start of each turn while the song lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_SONG_ROUSING_FX.desc: +3 m movement while the song lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_SONG_BATTLE_FX.desc: +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage while the song lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_SONG_REFRAIN_FX.desc: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC while the song lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_SONG_NAMELESS_FX.desc: Blessed: +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws while the song lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_DANCE_WITCH_FX.desc: -2 to spell save DC and spell attack rolls while the dance lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_DANCE_MINUET_FX.desc: Takes 1d4 psychic damage at the start of each turn while the dance lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_DANCE_SLOW_FX.desc: -3 m movement while the dance lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_DANCE_POLKA_FX.desc: Deals 2 less damage while the dance lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_DANCE_FROLIC_FX.desc: Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws while the dance lasts.
strings.status.FFTJ_DANCE_FORBIDDEN_FX.desc: At the start of each turn: a 1 in 10 chance each of being Blinded, Silenced, Poisoned or Slowed.
strings.status.FFTJ_MAGICK_SURGE.name: Magick Surge
strings.status.FFTJ_MAGICK_SURGE.desc: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
strings.status.FFTJ_STRENGTH_SURGE.name: Strength Surge
strings.status.FFTJ_BRAVERY_SURGE.name: Bravery Surge
strings.Beastmaster.Name: Beastmaster
strings.Beastmaster.Desc: Allied beasts, familiars and summons within 6 m of you get +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage. (FFT: gives nearby monsters a hidden ability.)
strings.status.FFTJ_BEASTMASTER_FX.desc: +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage near a Mime (Beastmaster).
strings.status.FFTJ_SOUL_BRAND.name: Soul Brand
strings.status.FFTJ_SOUL_BRAND.desc: Branded by a Soul Collector: if this creature dies before the brand fades, the party devours its soul.
strings.status.FFTJ_SOUL_KNOWN.name: Soul Known
strings.status.FFTJ_SOUL_KNOWN.desc: The party has already devoured a soul of this kind (Soul Codex on the Job Board).
strings.passive.FFTJ_SoulCharges.name: Soul Charges
strings.passive.FFTJ_SoulCharges.desc: 2 Wild Shape charges for Soul Incarnation (they come back after a short rest).
strings.passive.FFTJ_SoulCollector_4.name: Soul Collector Lv4
strings.passive.FFTJ_SoulCollector_4.desc: Job level 4 as your job: one more Wild Shape charge.
strings.passive.FFTJ_SoulCollector_7.name: Soul Collector Lv7
strings.passive.FFTJ_SoulCollector_7.desc: Job level 7 as your job: two more Wild Shape charges.
strings.status.FFTJ_DEAFENED.name: Deafened
strings.status.FFTJ_DEAFENED.desc: Ears ringing from a blast: disadvantage on Concentration saves and no reactions.
strings.Concentration.Name: Concentration
strings.status.FFTJ_ROOTED.name: Rooted
strings.status.FFTJ_SCOUTING.name: Scouting
strings.status.FFTJ_SCOUTING.desc: +5 to Perception checks (spotting traps and hidden things); attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.
